tasks.build:compiler:dev: cd zig-native && zig build install -Doptimize=debug -fincremental --prefix zig-out-dev
tasks.check:editor: deno task generate:editor && cd editor/tree-sitter-blot2 && XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.cache" tree-sitter test --config-path cli-config.json && XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.cache" tree-sitter parse --config-path cli-config.json --grammar-path . --quiet ../../examples/syntax.blot ../../examples/ecs.blot ../../examples/host_capabilities.blot ../../examples/host_io.blot
tasks.helix:install: deno task check:editor && deno task test:editor && deno run --allow-env=HOME,XDG_CONFIG_HOME --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run=tree-sitter,hx scripts/setup_helix.ts
tasks.test:guest: deno task package:pack && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env=BLOT_CLIENT_TEST_AMBIENT zig-native/tests compiler/*.test.ts -- zig-native/zig-out/bin/blotc
tasks.test:compiler: deno task build:compiler && deno task test:native && deno task test:guest
tasks.test: deno task test:editor && deno task test:compiler
tasks.check: deno fmt --check mod.ts deno.json compiler scripts .github && deno check mod.ts compiler/cli.ts compiler/installed_cli.ts scripts/*.ts && deno task test
tasks.package:build: deno task build:compiler && deno task package:pack
